caseName: Brinkerhoff-Faris Trust & Savings Co. v. Hill
caseNameFull: Brinkerhoff-Faris Trust & Savings Co. v. Hill, Treasurer
attorneys: Mr. Roy W. Rucker for petitioner., Mr. Lieutellus Cunningham for respondent.

opinions.text: On further consideration, the order of December 2, 1929, denying the petition for certiorari herein to the Supreme Court of. Missouri is revoked and the petition is now granted.
